seo.title: How We Help · Greatstone International
seo.description: Every organisation has the potential to become stronger. Greatstone helps organisations transform with confidence, strengthen organisational capability and invest in technology that matters.

lines.text: Every organisation has the potential to become stronger.
The question is where that strength should begin.

props.body: The organisations that realise their potential are those that focus their leadership, capability and investment where they create the greatest long-term value.

props.heading: Begin with the organisational priority
props.intro: Greatstone organises its work around three strategic priorities that executive leaders recognise within their own organisations. Start with the priority that matches where your organisation is, rather than with how Greatstone is arranged internally.

items.title: Transform with Confidence
items.text: For organisations undertaking significant strategic, operational or organisational transformation.

items.title: Strengthen Organisational Capability
items.text: For organisations requiring specialist expertise, advisory capability or implementation support to strengthen specific areas of the organisation.

items.title: Invest in Technology That Matters
items.text: For organisations seeking to apply the right technologies to the right organisational priorities in order to strengthen capability and create meaningful organisational value.

props.heading: Or browse the full catalogue
props.intro: The three priorities above are where most conversations start. If you already know what you are looking for, every service Greatstone offers is listed here, searchable and grouped.

props.headline: Let’s Build a Stronger Organisation
props.body: The journey towards a stronger organisation begins with a conversation. Let’s begin by understanding your organisation, your ambitions and the challenges that matter most.

seo.title: GS Agentic Manager · Greatstone International
seo.description: A digital office for your organisation: people and AI agents in clear roles on your own instance, set up by Greatstone where it fits, with your people approving what matters.

props.headline: A digital office for the work that comes round every week
props.body: An AI agent team, set up for one area of your work, in your own hosted instance. Your people direct it. Every task is on record, and it stops for a person where you decide.

props.headline: Built for organisations where skilled people do too much repeatable work.

items.text: You have 11 to 250 people and the same reports, drafts, research and follow-ups come round every week.
Your team already tries AI tools, but the results depend on who used them and nobody can see what was done.
You want the hours back without hiring, and without handing control to a black box.

props.heading: What every digital office starts with

items.title: Your own instance
items.text: A separate, hosted office for your organisation only. Your work and data are not shared with other clients.

items.title: An agent team set up for your work
items.text: We start with one area of work, such as operations, research or content, and give each agent a role, instructions and a manager.

items.title: Connections you agree
items.text: We connect the systems you agree once a technical check confirms each one. Access is held per agent and can be revoked at any time.

items.title: Approval points you choose
items.text: Agents work within budgets and stop for a person wherever you decide they should.

items.title: A record of every task
items.text: You can see what each agent did and why, task by task.

items.title: Hosting and maintenance
items.text: We host your instance, maintain the platform and keep backups. The terms of this service are written into your agreement.

props.heading: One setup, one recurring service, one optional review.

items.title: Tailored setup
items.text: A one-off engagement, charged separately: agents and their instructions, connections to the systems you agree, an introduction for your team, training and your acceptance.

items.title: Recurring service
items.text: Hosting of your own instance and platform maintenance, including backups. Your people direct the agents and run the daily work.

items.title: Quality review (optional)
items.text: A fixed number of hours on a set cadence to improve agent instructions, tools, workflows and model choice. It improves your digital office. It does not run your business.

items.title: Executive Discovery
items.text: Free. Is there something worth exploring?

items.title: Initial assessment
items.text: Free. Where technology and AI could help, with an indicative scope.

items.title: Agreement
items.text: A written scope and a deposit before any paid work.

items.title: Deep Dive and blueprint
items.text: We map how the work is done and give you an actionable blueprint.

items.title: Digital office
items.text: Only where it fits: tailored setup, then a recurring service.

props.body: Agents do not move money, sign anything, give regulated advice or make decisions about people. They do not replace your team; they take repeatable work off it. AI use stays within a budget you approve, and work beyond it stops for a person. We do not build bespoke software inside this service. If the work needs any of these, we say so in the Deep Dive and scope it separately.

props.heading: Not sure where to start?
props.intro: Two free tools. One shows how ready you are. The other shows what the manual work costs.

items.title: AI readiness check
items.text: Find out where AI can help your business first, and what has to be in place before it does.

items.title: AI cost calculator
items.text: See what your manual work costs you today. This is an estimate of your own time and spend, not a price for our services.

items.a: Your organisation has its own separate instance, which no other client shares. Which AI providers handle your work, and on whose accounts, is agreed with you before setup. Data processing terms are part of your agreement.
You are. A named person in your organisation decides where agents stop for approval, and can override or pause them. Agents work within budgets, and you can see every task they did.

items.q: Which AI models do you use?
items.a: The digital office works with models from more than one provider. Which models your agents use is agreed with you, based on the work, your data and your budget. When a better model arrives, an agent can move to it without rebuilding the team.

items.q: What kind of work can the agents do?
items.a: Repeatable knowledge work: first drafts, research, reports, content, summaries, follow-ups and routine checks. We start with one area of work and the work that comes round every week.

Setup is a one-off fee, agreed in writing. A recurring fee covers hosting of your own instance and platform maintenance, and the optional quality review is priced separately. AI use follows a route and a budget you agree with us. You see every figure in writing before you commit.

items.q: Is this a software product or a consultancy?
items.a: Both, deliberately. The consultancy comes first: we only propose a digital office where the blueprint shows it fits. We set it up on software we maintain, and your people run it. You do not buy a licence and work it out alone.

props.headline: Tell us which work keeps coming back.
props.body: A free Executive Discovery is usually enough to see whether a digital office would help, and where it would start.

seo.title: Proof · Greatstone International
seo.description: How Greatstone runs its own operations as a digital office of people and agents, what a demonstration shows, and how we measure results with each client.

props.headline: We run Greatstone this way. Then we set it up for you.
props.body: We publish a client result only when the client has approved the wording. Until then, this page shows what we can stand behind today: how we run our own company, and how we will measure yours.

props.headline: Our agents work in teams, with managers, budgets and people who approve.
props.body: Greatstone’s product, marketing, engineering and release work runs on the same kind of agent team we set up for clients. Each agent has a role, a manager and a budget. Work is tracked task by task. Changes to our own systems are checked by one agent and approved by a person before they go live. This is our own company, not a client result, and we will show it to you working.

items.title: A goal and the team working on it
items.text: Who does what, and who manages whom.

items.title: A task from start to finish
items.text: The brief, the work, the review, the approval.

items.title: The controls
items.text: Budgets, approval points, and what happens when an agent is unsure.

items.title: The cost
items.text: What the work used, by agent.

props.body: The Deep Dive records a starting point for the work in scope: how long it takes today, how often it happens and who does it. When your digital office has run for an agreed period, we compare against it with you. Those are the only figures we will quote to you, and the only ones we will ever publish about you, with your permission.

seo.title: About Greatstone · Greatstone International
seo.description: Greatstone exists to help organisations become stronger. Our purpose, our philosophy, the character of the institution and the people who do the work.

props.body: Everything we do, and everything we decline to do, is measured against that single purpose.

props.headline: What We Believe
props.body: Strong organisations are built deliberately. They are built by leaders who understand what matters before deciding what must change, and who are willing to look honestly at how their organisation actually works rather than how it is described. That belief shapes how Greatstone engages. We begin with understanding rather than assumption, we let evidence rather than instinct guide what follows, and we measure success by the strength an organisation retains long after our involvement ends.
props.coda: This is not a methodology we apply to organisations. It is the standard we hold ourselves to.

props.heading: The Character of the Institution
props.intro: Organisations choose their partners carefully, and rightly so. These are the characteristics that shape how Greatstone works, and the ones our clients hold us to.

items.title: We look where others stop looking
items.text: The answer is usually in the part everyone had agreed to overlook. Examining it is uncomfortable and it is where the value is, so we go there first.

items.title: We build capability, not dependency
items.text: The measure of an engagement is what the organisation can do once it concludes. We are not a supplier to be managed. We are a foundation to be built upon.

items.title: We say things plainly
items.text: If a recommendation cannot be explained to the people who will live with it, the thinking behind it is not finished. Clarity is a discipline, not a style.

items.title: Understanding Before Action
items.text: Every meaningful initiative begins with understanding. Before recommending change, Greatstone develops a clear understanding of the organisation, its objectives and the factors that will determine long-term success. Only then can meaningful progress begin.

items.title: Evidence Before Transformation
items.text: Transformation should always be guided by evidence rather than assumption. Every recommendation should be informed by organisational understanding, sound judgement and objective insight, creating the confidence required for meaningful and sustainable transformation.

items.title: Execution with Purpose
items.text: Every initiative should contribute to a clearly defined organisational objective. Transformation, specialist expertise and technology should never become objectives in themselves. They should always strengthen the organisation they exist to serve.

items.title: Capability That Endures
items.text: The measure of success is not the completion of an engagement. It is the capability the organisation retains, the confidence leadership gains and the strength the organisation continues to build long after the engagement has concluded.

props.body: Greatstone brings two decades of work inside organisations, across a broad range of industries and at every level from the executive team to the people doing the work each day. That experience is why we begin with understanding. We have seen enough organisations to know that the presenting problem is rarely the real one, and that the difference between an initiative that holds and one that quietly unwinds is almost always decided before any change begins. Today we bring that experience together with AI-enabled automation, and we run our own company on the same agent teams we set up for clients.

props.body: Senior people, involved directly rather than represented. Your engagement is led by the people you meet, and the remaining seats on your team are named once the engagement is confirmed.

seo.title: Executive Intelligence · Greatstone International
seo.description: The quality of an organisation’s decisions will never exceed the quality of its thinking. Greatstone’s perspective on organisations, leadership, technology and transformation.

lines.text: The quality of an organisation’s decisions will never exceed the quality of its thinking.

props.body: Executive Intelligence is where Greatstone shares the thinking that shapes its perspective on organisations, leadership, technology and transformation, helping executive leaders think more clearly about the decisions that matter most. Because stronger organisations begin with stronger thinking.

props.heading: The Intelligence Centres
props.intro: Executive Intelligence is not a marketing function, a news service or a content library. It exists to help executive leaders think more clearly about the challenges, opportunities and decisions that shape stronger organisations.

items.title: Understand AI Before You Adopt It
items.text: Artificial Intelligence presents extraordinary opportunities for organisations prepared to apply it thoughtfully. Its greatest value is realised when it strengthens organisational capability, supports strategic priorities and delivers measurable organisational outcomes. AI Market Intelligence helps executive leaders understand where Artificial Intelligence genuinely matters, and where it does not.

items.title: Think Beyond Today’s Challenges
items.text: The strongest organisations prepare for tomorrow while continuing to perform today. Organisational Thinking explores the ideas, leadership perspectives and strategic observations that help executive teams strengthen organisational capability, improve long-term performance and navigate change with confidence.

items.title: Invest in Technology That Matters
items.text: Technology creates value only when it is applied where it makes the greatest organisational difference. The objective is not simply to adopt new technologies. It is to apply the right technology, to the right organisational priorities, at the right time. Technology Intelligence helps executive leaders make informed technology investment decisions that strengthen capability, support strategic objectives and create lasting organisational value.

items.title: Executive Briefings
items.text: Executive leaders need insight they can apply rather than information they already know. Executive Briefings distil complex developments into concise executive perspectives, helping leadership understand what has changed, why it matters and what should be considered next. Every briefing is designed to strengthen executive judgement through thoughtful analysis and practical insight.

props.heading: Where Artificial Intelligence genuinely matters,
props.body: Greatstone’s standing briefing on developments in Artificial Intelligence, interpreted for their organisational implications rather than reported as news. Every entry answers what has changed, why it matters and what should be considered next.

props.body: Executive Intelligence shows how Greatstone thinks. A conversation is where we begin to understand your organisation.

seo.title: The Climb · Maturity Model · Greatstone International
seo.description: Every business sits somewhere on the mountain: pebble, plateau or peak. We meet you where you are, read where you stand, and find the shortest honest route up.

props.headline: Pebble. Plateau.
props.body: Every business sits somewhere on the mountain. We meet you where you are, and we climb. No vanity scores, no theatre. Just a clear read of where you stand and the shortest honest route up.

tiers.title: Surviving.
tiers.desc: Manual, reactive, held together by heroics. The work gets done, but it costs hours nobody is counting.

tiers.title: Organised.
tiers.desc: Process exists, some automation has landed, things are improving. But momentum stalls without a clear next move.

tiers.title: Compounding.
tiers.desc: Intelligent, integrated, ahead of the curve. Every system feeds the next and the gains stack on themselves.

props.headline: Laggard to
props.body: Altitude isn’t a verdict, it’s a starting line. The same climb, read as a posture, dim to lime.

items.name: Laggard
items.text: Behind the field and feeling it. The basics aren’t in place, so every day leaks time to work that should run itself.

items.name: Follower
items.text: Keeping pace by watching others. Capable, but reactive: reacting to the market instead of shaping your own move.

items.name: Leader
items.text: Out in front in your category. Systems compound, decisions move fast, and the hours you bought back fund the next gain.

items.name: Pioneer
items.text: Setting the standard others chase. Intelligent by default: the foundation is so deep that growth feels inevitable.

props.headline: Let's find out where you
props.body: The Deep Dive scores your organisation across all eight pillars and shows you the shortest honest route up, from pebble to plateau to peak.
